metadata.description: aidd: the toolkit for AI-Driven Development (AIDD), one loop from intent to production with change control at its core, with a skill, an MCP server, edit-time hooks, and an optional delivery team of agent roles.

plugins.name: aidd
plugins.description: AIDD, one loop from intent to production with change control at its core: one skill plus the aidd verifier as MCP tools and an edit-time hook.

plugins.name: aidd-team
plugins.description: Optional: run the aidd loop as a delivery team of agent roles, each applying its discipline's industry standards, with a domain pack per domain and practice skills per kind of work, every standard carrying a checked date (or a reviewed date for a practice), and an edition and source where the document has one. Ships one command per team flow, from onboarding a repository and writing a proposal to shipping and the retrospective. Needs the aidd plugin.
